blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Senate impeachment court has asserted that the petition filed by two of its members before the Supreme Court (SC) on the number of votes required to convict Vice President Sara Duterte is fatally premature. In a statement on Thursday, spokesperson for the court Atty. Reginald Tongol, shared the Senate’s Nov. 3 response to the SC petition for certiorari and prohibition filed by Senators Robinhood Padilla and Christopher “Bong” Go on the impeachment court’s revised voting rule. “The petition is fatally premature and warrants no Temporary Restraining Order or Status Quo Ante Order because the September 23 pro […]...
